correctness.rationale: A man proposes exactly to the initial segment of his list ending at his men-optimal partner, so total proposals equal the sum of the three men-optimal partner ranks. A fresh implementation independently enumerated all 6^6=46,656 labeled profiles, obtaining proposal counts 10,368, 15,552, 14,256, 5,832 and 648 for totals 3 through 7. Independently testing all six perfect matchings per profile reproduced the known stable-matching marginals 34,080, 11,484 and 1,092 and exactly the package's joint table. The resulting mean, variance and conditional means follow by exact arithmetic.

originality.rationale: The 2024 exact-enumeration paper already gives the one-round atom and the marginal distribution of the number of stable matchings for three-by-three profiles. It does not tabulate total proposal counts beyond one round, men-optimal rank multisets, the seven-proposal cutoff, or the joint proposal-count/stable-multiplicity distribution. General random stable-marriage work studies asymptotic proposal complexity rather than this exact finite law. The audited joint census therefore adds a natural complete finite benchmark while explicitly treating the known marginals as prior.

value.rationale: The three-by-three market is the smallest size with three possible stable matchings and nontrivial proposal dynamics beyond one round. A complete exact proposal law, sharp support cutoff, rank decomposition and coupling to stable multiplicity form a natural finite benchmark for random deferred acceptance rather than an arbitrary enumeration.
residual_risks: An unindexed exercise, thesis, supplementary computation or OEIS entry could contain the same small-n proposal histogram.

final_claim: Under independent uniform strict preferences in a three-by-three market, men-proposing Gale–Shapley makes exactly 3 through 7 proposals with probabilities 2/9, 1/3, 11/36, 1/8 and 1/72, never 8 or 9; the theorem also gives the exact men-optimal rank-multiset law and the full joint distribution with the number of stable matchings.
limitations: Exactly three men and three women with independent uniform strict complete preferences and men-proposing Gale–Shapley only.
The one-round atom and stable-count marginals are prior art and are used only as external checks.
